thread:
max: quick sync - Nordica (OEM partner) asked for a co-sell POC. Scope: secure onboarding, EU data residency, pricing delta for reserved vs hosted, and a joint deployment diagram. They want a demo week of Jun 24-28. Who can pick which items?

leah: I can take the Security Questionnaire (SecQ) and DLP confirmation. We need to confirm whether partner telemetry will include any identifiers; ask them to fill the data classification form.

dan: I'll do the joint deployment diagram and a short runbook for the POC. Need to know whether they prefer VPC peering or private connect. Also will add a canary routing plan so we can roll traffic safely.

irene: I'll produce a quick pricing comparison: hosted API, Dedicated reserved (monthly commit), and a private appliance estimate. Will include expected unit costs at their projected 150 QPS. Ballpark numbers by EOD.

max: timeline: SecQ draft by Mon EOD (we can fast-track review), arch + runbook by Tue mid-day, pricing spreadsheet by EOD today if possible. Partner contact is Emil (Nordica PM) - I'll DM details.

leah: SecQ notes - main asks flagged: (1) EU data residency & export controls, (2) KMS/customer-managed keys, (3) log retention and redaction. I'll attach a checklist. Also requesting SOC2 and ISO certs; legal will need to provide cert bundle.

dan: Arch notes (quick bullet draft):

```
- App (Nordica) in EU region VPC
- Option A: VPC peering to Redwood Private control plane + Dedicated GPU pool in same region
- Option B: Private deployment (on-prem virtual image) for strict residency
- Auth: SAML SSO + SCIM for provisioning; partner IdP metadata exchange needed
- Keys: KMS customer-managed key for persisted caches and artifacts
- Network: egress-only from partner -> Redwood, strict ACLs, no inbound from internet
- Rollout: start with 5% canary by route tag -> monitor latency & errors -> 100%
```

I'll render this into a PNG and a simple SVG diagram. Any specifics to include?

infra-bot: Internal POC checklist: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/partner-poc-checklist (link)

irene: Pricing assumptions I'll use: avg request size 400 tokens, peak 220 QPS, baseline 150 QPS steady. For dedicated reserved I assume 4x A100-equivalent GPUs per pool. Placeholder numbers: reserved monthly = $Y, hosted tokens extra = $Z/token. Will add sensitivity to batching and quantization (we recommend int4 for cost/latency).

leah: On logs: partner claims no PII, but we need a signed attestation. I'll add a DLP control section in SecQ and ask partner to sign. Also ask Security for an exception workflow if they forward any debug traces.

max: Legal input: does DPA + addendum for EU residency require additional fees? Also partner asked about SLA >99.9 for production - we should flag Dedicated + Premium support as the path.

leah: I'll loop in legal after SecQ draft. Can legal confirm what certs bundle we can share publicly?

dan: For the runbook I'll include quick commands to spin canary route and rollback snippet (example below):

```
# create canary route for partner traffic
redwood routes create --name nordica-canary --match "header:partner-id=\"nordica\"" --model oss-13b-quant4 --pool dedicated-eu-1 --traffic 0.05
# rollback
redwood routes update --name nordica-canary --traffic 0
```

max: Perfect. Action items summary: leah = SecQ + DLP attestation, dan = arch + runbook + diagram, irene = pricing spreadsheet + sensitivity analysis, max = partner comms + legal loop. Demo window we suggested - Emil to confirm Wed or Thu that week.

irene: I'll upload the spreadsheet to this thread by 18:00 UTC. It will include a column for "estimated monthly committed" and a column for "hosted per-token" costs, plus a short note on expected latency gains with int4 quant.

leah: SecQ draft will include a short section on monitoring: what logs we retain, where traces are stored, and retention policy. ETA Mon 09:00 UTC if InfoSec approves fast-track.

max: If any blocker (legal certs, infra peering approvals), ping me ASAP. Thanks team :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: submit peering request at least 72 hours before demo window.
